text:
anya: Hey — quick unblock question. Can someone approve https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823 ? It's a CODEOWNERS bulk sync touching infra/, serving/, and pkg/owner-metadata and GH shows: "required review from CODEOWNERS". We need this merged today for the infra deploy window.

kevin: Who's on rotation for eng-platform owners this week? @olivia?

olivia: I _am_ the rotation lead but I'm on PTO until Tue morning. I can approve if it's urgent, but would prefer not to if Kevin or someone else already has ownership.

sachin: FYI the current CODEOWNERS maps to teams rather than individuals:
```
# .github/CODEOWNERS (snippet)
/infra/        @eng-infra-owners
/serving/      @eng-runtime-owners
/pkg/owner-metadata @eng-platform-owners
```
Per repo policy a review by any listed team member counts, but GH blocks when there are branch protection rules that require an "explicit" approval from an individual listed (we've run into this).

anya: Breaking this into smaller PRs would delay us. Is there a safe fast-track?

kevin: Options: 1) Ask a platform lead to do an explicit approve (fast). 2) Admin force-merge (audit log required). 3) Add a temporary CODEOWNERS override in the PR (not ideal). If the change is purely mechanical we can fast-track with lead sign-off.

anya: It's mechanical: sync script applied new headers and path updates, no behavior changes. PR diff is ~120 files but same code.

kevin: OK — I'll ping @platform-leads for an explicit sign-off and drop a note in the PR describing "mechanical bulk sync; platform lead review".

deploy-bot: PR #4823 status: merge-queue blocked — required_review (CODEOWNERS)

olivia: If you need me to DM a checklist I can do that remotely (short checks only). Otherwise platform-leads is the faster route.

kevin: @platform-leads assigning — can someone give a quick :eyes: and approve if this looks like a mechanical sync? I will not merge without at least one explicit sign-off in the PR comments.

platform-leads: Spotted. Quick look — changes are consistent with the sync script. We approve for merge, but please add an audit note in the PR: "approved-by: platform-leads; reason: mechanical CODEOWNERS sync; verified by kevin/anya".

anya: Added the audit note and bumped the PR description with the script name and run-id.

kevin: Great. I'm going to merge once CI completes. Leaving a 10m window for any objections.

sachin: Suggestion for follow-up: let's add a small governance doc in the repo about emergency owner overrides and admin merge process so this is less hand-wavy next time.

anya: Agreed — I'll draft a short README for .github/ with the override process.

kevin: CI passed. Merging now (sha: abc1234, merged by kevin). :rocket:

anya: Thanks y'all — that unblocks the infra deploy window.

olivia: Thanks, everyone. Back on Tue if any fallout. :wave:

deploy-bot: PR #4823 merged into main by kevin at sha abc1234
